          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized by
            removing every non-digit character and must contain exactly 10 digits
            after stripping; the normalized 10-digit value is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a

          type: string

          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'

          format: date

          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Request-only flag used on create. When true, the owner may be created

            request is rejected with 409 Conflict. Not persisted and not returned.

      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.

        - type: object

              type: integer

              example: 1
              readOnly: true

              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The owner's initials as the upper-cased first letters of the first
                and last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>', where LAST3 is
                the upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN is a
                global 4-digit zero-padded sequence number.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>',
                where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by all owners that belong to the same
                household (i.e. that have the same last name and address). Owners who
                knowingly share a household - created with 'sharesHousehold' true -
                are assigned the same value.
              type: string
              example: 'a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners that already existed, at the time this owner
                was created, sharing the same first and last name
                (case-insensitively). Zero when the name was unique on create.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipTier:
              title: Membership tier
              description: >-
                The owner's membership tier. 'GOLD' when the owner's household
                (owners sharing the same householdId) has 3 or more members after
                the owner was created. Otherwise 'SILVER' when the name was unique

                'BRONZE' in all other cases.
              type: string
              example: 'SILVER'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-

              type: string

              readOnly: true
